subject.title: Unify the talk voice animation across iOS/watchOS/macOS/Android and drive it with real audio levels

question: Should maintainers pursue the broad cross-platform unified waveform through the existing linked PR, split it into staged native-app PRs, or defer the voice-animation redesign?
rationale: The request spans multiple native apps, live mic metering, playback envelopes, fallback semantics, and voice-note UI, while the issue is protected and the linked PR is open and conflicting, so automation should not choose the product scope or close path.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102901 as the implementation vehicle after resolving conflicts and adding real platform proof.

options.title: Split by platform
options.body: Keep this issue canonical but ask for smaller PRs that land shared waveform math and one platform integration at a time.

options.title: Defer the redesign
options.body: Leave the current platform-specific animations in place until maintainers commit to the native voice UX direction and proof budget.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102901 as the implementation vehicle after resolving conflicts and adding real platform proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the issue, authored the linked implementation PR, and have the strongest recent history across the affected talk/voice paths.
